description: Assigned Speaker 5 to Charlie Glick despite Charlie having declined the meeting invite. Attendee RSVP status was available in the calendar data but was not checked before making the assignment.
correction: Should have filtered to accepted attendees only before reasoning about who could have been present. Declined attendees cannot be speakers.
systemic_fix: During speaker ID, always filter calendar attendees to accepted/tentative only. Declined attendees must be excluded from candidate pool before any reasoning begins.
